topic: Waiting on a withheld final paycheck vs enforcing the deadline (Leon vs Opal)

scenes.narration: His boss sat on his last paycheck for two whole months. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera in a courtroom beside a giant withheld paycheck locked in a cage, comic burst banner reads PAY WITHHELD, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Leon and Opal both quit jobs and await final paychecks.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man leon and woman opal in the courtroom, each waiting empty-handed for a final paycheck, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: State law sets strict deadlines for paying a final paycheck.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a glowing law book on the courtroom bench labeled FINAL PAYCHECK DEADLINE, a calendar beside it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Leon's boss stalls, vaguely promising to mail the check eventually.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a boss at a desk shrugging beside man leon, a comic banner reads WE WILL MAIL IT LATER, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Leon waits quietly, believing he has no real legal options.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man leon sitting quietly at home doing nothing, a sign beside him labeled NO OPTIONS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Opal looks up her state's final paycheck deadline right away.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman opal at a laptop reading a page labeled STATE FINAL PAY DEADLINE, a calendar circled, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She sends a written demand citing the legal payment deadline.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman opal mailing a letter stamped WRITTEN DEMAND, a deadline date highlighted, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Opal files a wage claim with the state labor department.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman opal submitting a form at a government office window labeled STATE LABOR DEPARTMENT WAGE CLAIM, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Months pass and Leon still hasn't seen his final wages.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man leon with empty pockets, a calendar showing months passing, his final wages still missing, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His delay wrecks his rent, and the trail goes cold.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man leon facing an overdue rent notice, a cold trail of paperwork fading away, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Opal gets her wages plus a waiting-time penalty on top.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman opal holding a check plus an extra bonus slip stamped WAITING TIME PENALTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Know your final pay deadline and file a wage claim fast. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel in the courtroom, a clipboard reads KNOW THE DEADLINE FILE A CLAIM, comic burst banner reads DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
